yourEmailAppShouldOpenWithAPreparedMessa: Your email app should open with a prepared message. No data has been submitted to a server.

heroDescription: From the first trial to membership, invoices and clothing vouchers. Bring administration, coaches and families together around your bexio club records.
floatingDescription: The trainer’s view of club life.
featuresDescription: Organise the work between registration, coaching, membership and finance, with the next step visible to the right people.
featureTeamsDescription: Team rosters and coaching roles, with each player’s emergency, parent and contact phone numbers ready to tap and call. Coaches see their assigned teams without needing their own bexio account.
featureTrialsDescription: Follow applicants from team assignment to admission. Keep external onboarding tasks, contact details and documents together.
featureTrainingDescription: Maintain recurring training times, locations, age groups and coaches. Holiday periods inform trial-training suggestions.
featureBillingDescription: Track membership invoices and paid, open or reminder status by team. Share invoice links via WhatsApp, or initiate printed postal letters through optional Pingen integration. Coaches see their team’s contribution status.
featureVouchersDescription: Connect eligible membership benefits with personalised PDF/QR vouchers, shop validation, expiry tracking and settlement.
featureChatDescription: Team conversations with history, replies and image previews, plus options for attachments, polls and call-ups. Available rooms depend on the club setup and selected profile.
featureOperationsDescription: Prepare team transfers, track departures and export club statistics. Review member requests and keep email delivery issues visible.
featureSelfServiceDescription: Members and parents view the selected member’s badge, team, invoices and vouchers, and request personal-data changes or cancellation for admin review.
bexioTitle: Your club records stay in bexio.
bexioDescription: bexio is the membership and financial system of record. kick-playr brings the surrounding workflows into one interface. Federation and external team-tool tasks are assisted with information and links.
rolesEyebrow: THE RIGHT VIEW FOR EACH ROLE
rolesDescription: Switch between the contexts available to your account, including a parent’s view of a represented member.
roleAdminDescription: Manage registrations, onboarding, invoices, vouchers, season changes, requests and club configuration.
roleCoachDescription: See assigned teams, trials, contribution status and vouchers. Call a player’s parents or emergency contacts directly from their listed numbers. Billing operations remain with administration.
roleMemberDescription: View your selected member’s information and submit requests. Available chats follow the selected profile.
workflowEyebrow: FROM FIRST CONTACT TO CLUB LIFE
workflowTrialDescription: Review registrations, find matching age groups and training slots, and track trial progress through to admission.
workflowAdmissionDescription: Follow the external onboarding checklist and membership invoices in bexio. Keep outstanding steps and payment status visible.
workflowVoucherDescription: Issue eligible clothing vouchers, follow shop fulfilment and settlement, and keep member information and seasonal changes organised.
pricingDescription: The kick-playr offer for additional clubs is being shaped around an existing Swiss club application. Pricing and pilot scope will be discussed directly.
pricingCardTitle: Explore a pilot for your club
pricingCardDescription: Start with your bexio setup, team structure and the administrative processes you want to simplify.
pilotDescription: We’re speaking with Swiss football clubs using bexio about adapting these connected workflows to their club.
contactHint: Opens a prepared email in your email app. Your club details are only sent when you send that email.
faqAudienceAnswer: Swiss grassroots football clubs using bexio, with workflows for administrators, coaches, members and parents. We’ll discuss whether your club’s setup fits the proposed pilot.
faqAvailabilityAnswer: The original service was built for FC Rot-Weiss Winikon (FCRWW) in Uster, the first pilot club for the kick-playr SaaS service. The operational reference app is in German. Onboarding, enabled features and pilot terms for additional clubs are agreed separately. The previews on this page are illustrative.
faqBexioAnswer: Yes. A bexio account is the minimum requirement for membership records, invoices and payment status. Pingen postal delivery and a connected mailbox for bounced-email monitoring are optional opt-ins. Other ERP connectors are outside the current scope.
faqIntegrationsAnswer: Tasks for tools such as clubcorner, NDS/J+S, SpielerPlus and WhatsApp are supported with details, links and completion tracking. This does not mean every step is carried out automatically inside those services.
faqLanguagesQuestion: Does the app support these four languages?
faqLanguagesAnswer: This website is available in English, German, French and Italian. The operational reference app is in German. App-language requirements for another club need to be discussed as part of its setup.
faqPricingAnswer: Commercial pricing is not finalised. Pilot scope, services and terms will be discussed directly with interested clubs.
previewEmergencyDetail: Player-specific phone numbers, tap to call
memberPreviewDescription: Each member can sign in to view their own club data and request corrections when something changes. Parents can access a represented member’s profile. The club reviews data-change requests before applying them.
memberCorrectionDetail: Propose updated details for the club to review.
memberReviewNote: Changes are reviewed by club administration.
setupEyebrow: A SIMPLE START FOR YOUR CLUB
setupDescription: A bexio account is the minimum requirement. Choose optional services only when your club needs them, then complete a guided setup with your club details.
bexioRequirementDescription: Connect your existing account through bexio OAuth for membership and invoice workflows.
pingenDescription: When a postal invoice or reminder is needed, administration can initiate printing and postal delivery through the optional Pingen integration.
mailboxDescription: Opt in to monitor bounced and undeliverable emails. Review delivery failures and correct contact details when needed.
onboardingEmailDescription: Prepare the club’s email templates and wording.
onboardingConnectDescription: Authorise the connection to your bexio account.
onboardingMappingsDescription: Map categories, tags, roles and teams to the club workflows.
onboardingShopDescription: Set the partner shop, voucher articles and club contribution.
onboardingPeopleDescription: Add the names and responsibilities of the people managing your club.
faqDeliveryQuestion: How can invoices be shared or posted?
faqDeliveryAnswer: Administration can share prepared invoice links via WhatsApp. For printed postal invoices or reminders, opt in to Pingen and initiate the letter delivery when needed. Mailbox integration for bounced-email monitoring is a separate opt-in.
faqSetupAnswer: Your club name and logo, email texts, bexio OAuth authorisation and bexio mappings, sport shop details, and the names of your club management and responsible contacts. Pingen and mailbox access are only configured if you choose them.
originDescription: The original version of the service was designed and built for FC Rot-Weiss Winikon (FCRWW) in Uster, Switzerland. FCRWW is the first pilot club for the kick-playr SaaS service.
newsDescription: Updates from kick-playr and our pilot clubs.
